objective_convention: Q = gross_operational_cost (settlement excluded; the frozen primary). EUR content in Q of a family = sum_b w_b V_b with w_b = Y_y D_d (1+r)^-(y-y0) (get_primal_value weight); SIGNED as recorded: negative where IPOPT leaves the slack inside its relaxed lower bound. Q contains the signed content.
sign_convention: signed_eur_weighted < 0 means the slack Vars sit below 0 inside the IPOPT bound relaxation (Q lowered by that amount); positive_part_bound_eur_weighted is a rigorous upper bound on sum_j a_j max(x_j, 0), the economic (penalty-paid) content

floor_premise.basis: IPOPT bound_relax_factor default 1e-8 (relaxed lb = -1e-8 * max(1, |lb|), lb = 0), honor_original_bounds no (IPOPT 3.14 default); interior-point iterates stay inside the relaxed bounds; no case/ESS options file sets either option (scanned); a cell record that states the options in force must state exactly these values (asserted; record_option_mentions lists what each record states)

pen_node_balance_p.needle: total += base * PENALTY_NODE_BALANCE * (model.slack_node_balance_p_up[i, s_m, s_o, p] + model.slack_node_balance_p_down[i, s_m, s_o, p])

pen_branch_ij.needle: total += base * PENALTY_CURRENT * (model.slack_flow_ij_sqr[b, s_m, s_o, p])

pen_flex_p_day_balance.needle: total += base * PENALTY_FLEXIBILITY * (model.slack_flex_p_balance_up[c, s_m, s_o] + model.slack_flex_p_balance_down[c, s_m, s_o])

pen_local_ess_closure.needle: total += base * PENALTY_ESS_BALANCE * (model.slack_es_soc_final_up[e, s_m, s_o] + model.slack_es_soc_final_down[e, s_m, s_o])

pen_shared_ess_closure.needle: total += base * PENALTY_SHARED_ESS_BALANCE * (model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_up[e, s_m0, s_o0] + model.slack_shared_es_soc_final_down[e, s_m0, s_o0])

detector_voltage.needle: components['voltage_slack'] += probability * pe.value(voltage_slack_penalty(model, network, s_m, s_o, params))

detector_block_weight.needle: blocks[('TSO', None, year, day)] = {name: weight * value for name, value in components.items()}

esso_sigma_vars.needle: model.slack_es_pnet_up = pe.Var(model.years, model.days, model.periods, domain=pe.NonNegativeReals, initialize=0.0)

esso_sigma_row.needle: model.energy_storage_operation_agg.add(model.es_pnet[y, d, p] == agg_pnet + model.slack_es_pnet_up[y, d, p] - model.slack_es_pnet_down[y, d, p])

esso_sigma_penalty.needle: slack_penalty += PENALTY_ESSO_SLACK * (model.slack_es_pnet_up[y_inv, d, p] + model.slack_es_pnet_down[y_inv, d, p])

esso_D3_sum.needle: model.slack_es_pnet_up[y_inv, d, p] + model.slack_es_pnet_down[y_inv, d, p]

P5.prediction: every penalised slack at its zero bound on every certified row (EUR content < 1 EUR); any non-zero content is listed with its row (expert, Addendum 89 P5)
P5.reading: at its zero bound = every slack element of every penalised family in Q shown in [-f, 0] (f = 1e-8, the IPOPT relaxation), so its positive (penalty-paid) EUR content is 0; where an element is not established <= 0, the positive content is bounded by the family positive-part bound; the row holds when that refined bound is < 1 EUR
P5.reading_R2_reported_beside: |signed EUR content in Q| < 1 EUR (counts the relaxed-bound residue)
